title: On Rejecting the plan out of hand
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：reject　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reject 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the planner ① rejected the plan out of hand at once, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② rejects the plan out of hand in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ reject the plan out of hand at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ rejected the plan out of hand before — a line in the report for March 1971 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Rejecting the plan out of hand at once, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ reject the weak plants before spring in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Reject the weak plants before spring at once and never mention it again.

By 1984 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ rejects the weak plants before spring at once every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ rejected the plan out of hand again when nobody else would.

⑩ To reject the plan out of hand, my mother said in 1989, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody rejects the plan out of hand in the rain again and somebody must reject the plan out of hand at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 拒绝接受（一般过去式 rejected the plan out of hand：1977 年规划员头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 拒绝接受（一般现在 rejects the plan out of hand：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 拒绝接受（不定式 to reject the plan out of hand：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 拒绝接受（过去完成时 had rejected the plan out of hand：1971 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 拒绝接受（动名词 rejecting the plan out of hand 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 排斥（reject the weak plants before spring：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去排斥开春前把弱苗剔掉）
G. v. 排斥（reject the weak plants before spring：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 拒绝接受（后段两处：新来的市民照例 rejects the weak plants before spring，而母亲又一次 rejected the plan out of hand）

answers.why: reject 意为“拒绝接受”，1977 年规划员二话不说地拒绝接受当场就把那方案否了，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 rejected。
reject 意为“拒绝接受”，自那以后规划员淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 rejects。
reject 意为“拒绝接受”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯拒绝接受当场就把那方案否了”，此处为不定式 to reject the plan out of hand。
reject 意为“拒绝接受”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 1984 年之前就有人拒绝接受过，故用过去完成时 had rejected。
reject 意为“拒绝接受”，规划员说“拒绝接受当场就把那方案否了这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 rejecting the plan out of hand 作主语。
reject 意为“排斥”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去排斥开春前把弱苗剔掉”，should ever 之后用原形 reject the weak plants before spring。
reject 意为“排斥”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻排斥开春前把弱苗剔掉（reject the weak plants before spring at once），以后再也不要提起。
reject 意为“拒绝接受”，新来的市民每个年份都照例排斥开春前把弱苗剔掉，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 rejects。
reject 意为“拒绝接受”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地拒绝接受当场就把那方案否了，用一般过去式 rejected 叙述。
reject 意为“拒绝接受”，结尾那句是母亲 1989 年的话：要拒绝接受当场就把那方案否了，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reject 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the planner rejected the plan out of hand at once, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner rejects the plan out of hand in the rain whenever the district asks.
Rejecting the plan out of hand at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever reject the weak plants before spring in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new citizen from the next district rejects the weak plants before spring at once every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother rejected the plan out of hand again, and the district remembered that half.
